verdicts.title: Tutte Polynomials of Symmetric Hyperplane Arrangements
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Originally in 1954 the Tutte polynomial was a bivariate polynomial associated to a graph in order to enumerate the colorings of this graph and of its dual graph at the same time.
